text:
ellie: Heads up — customer reported that our autorouter invoked promo_apply instead of issuing a refund. They hit it from the support UI via a normal refund flow.
ellie: Repro steps I have: 1) open ticket #C-4821 2) click Refund -> enter amount -> submit 3) backend returned 202 but action executed was promo_apply.
ellie: Payload we send (sanitized):
```json
{
  "intent": "refund",
  "amount": 45.00,
  "currency": "USD",
  "metadata": {
    "case_id": "C-4821"
  }
}
```
raj: I saw a similar smell last week, was a signature overlap where a `voucher`/`promo` tool had a field named `amount` (string) and our fuzzy matcher prefers exact schema shape when confidence close.
sami: Can you paste the router decision logs? :eyes:
ellie: pasted below (anonymized):
```
INFO router: candidate_tools=[refund_tool, promo_apply_v1, store_credit]
INFO router: input_shape={intent:refund, amount:float, currency:str}
WARN selection: promo_apply_v1 score=0.62 refund_tool score=0.60
INFO selected=promo_apply_v1 fallback=None
```
raj: Score gap is tiny. Looks like promo_apply_v1 expects an `amount` too (legacy). If its schema lists amount as optional string, and our comparator converts incoming amount float->string sometimes, that could nudge the distance.
ops-oncall: Any deploys/rollouts around router model or schema registry in last 24h?
support-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out router-model v2.3 -> canary @ 2026-03-16T22:10Z by infra-team
sami: Bingo. v2.3 changed comparator to prefer fewer missing required fields over exact type match (minor perf tweak). That would make tools with optional amount win over required-but-typed refund_tool.
ellie: Customer impact: 3 tickets in last 8h misapplied promo credits instead of refunds. We're escalating - refunds executed as promos cause accounting and user confusion.
raj: Short-term mitigation: update routing config to force exact-type match for monetary fields (amount/currency) or bump refund_tool priority. Can we hotfix config?
ops-oncall: I can patch router-config to add bias +0.2 to refund_tool for all support-originated calls. Will do in 10m, rolling 50% traffic.
sami: Also recommend schema change: rename refund_tool.amount -> refund_amount or require integer cents to avoid ambiguous `amount` shadowing. Longer term.
ellie: Work items: 1) ops hotfix bias 2) run quick audit: find other tools with `amount` field that are optional 3) revert comparator change in canary if regression confirmed 4) notify billing for reconciliation.
raj: Quick repro script if someone wants to run locally:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/support/action \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -d '{"intent":"refund","amount":45.00,"currency":"USD"}'
```
support-bot: incident-tracker: created INC-2026-03-16-07 for misrouted-refund-to-promo
ops-oncall: patched refund bias on canary at 2026-03-16T22:35Z. Monitoring logs for selection score delta.
sami: After bias patch, selection logs show: refund_tool score=0.78 promo_apply_v1 score=0.55 selected=refund_tool
ellie: Confirmed with customer — they got refund and not a promo. Marking ticket as high priority for audit.
raj: I'll open a PR to change refund tool schema to require `amount_cents:int` and add a schema migration plan.
ellie: Thanks team. Final note: prioritize NOT breaking backward compatibility for older clients; we'll put conversion in router for a couple weeks. :thumbsup:
